items.title: Prince Harry's children moving school after two days over security concerns
items.author: Michael Holden
items.creator: Michael Holden
items.summary: The children of Britain's Prince Harry and his wife Meghan are to swap schools after just two days because of concerns over the security of transporting them, the couple's spokesperson said on Monday.
items.body:
The children of Britain's Prince Harry and his wife Meghan are to swap schools after just two days because of concerns over the security of transporting them, the couple's spokesperson said on Monday.
Last month, Harry, the younger son of King Charles, and his family [USN:L1N44H08P TEXT:"relocated"] to Britain after six years of living in California, with Prince Archie, 7, and Princess Lilibet, 5, starting school in September.
The location of their new home and details of the children's school have been kept private. But on Monday, a spokesperson for the couple, the Duke and Duchess of Sussex, confirmed reports that Archie and Lilibet were changing schools after just two days.
The distance between their home and the original school, with heavy traffic in the area, had caused concern for their security team.
"The decision for the children to move school was taken following a discussion with the family's security team about the practicalities of their current arrangements," the spokesperson said.
"The parents remain extremely grateful to all the teachers and staff for the love, care and effort they have shown their family. This decision should in no way be interpreted as a reflection on the school or the exceptional care the children have received there."
The couple stepped down from royal duties and moved to the U.S. in 2020, leading to estrangement and awkward relations with the royal family as they delivered a series of [USN:L8N2KT56C TEXT:"barbed comments"] about the institution.
Their return came as a surprise, with even the monarch unaware of their plans until just days before it became public.
Harry and Meghan are not living in a royal residence and will remain non-working royals, as agreed with the late Queen Elizabeth before their move.
Their status as private citizens was confirmed in a [USN:L8N44Z0W2 TEXT:"letter"] authorised by Charles and sent to senior British officials last week, a step which their spokesperson said had come as a surprise to Harry and Meghan.
The prince has also been critical of the government's decision to strip him and his family of automatic police protection afforded to other senior royals, with a bespoke system put in place instead.
Harry's security is currently being reviewed by a government committee, and the couple's spokesperson confirmed that Meghan's situation is also being looked at again for the first time since they moved away from Britain.

items.title: Exportação de café do Brasil salta no início de setembro; embarque de petróleo também dispara
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: As exportações brasileiras de café verde seguiram fortes no início de setembro, após o recorde histórico para o mês de agosto registrado pelo setor, com os embarques do grão aumentando mais de 50%, segundo dados da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior (Secex) divulgados nesta segunda-feira.
items.body:
As exportações brasileiras de café verde seguiram fortes no início de setembro, após o recorde histórico para o mês de agosto registrado pelo setor, com os embarques do grão aumentando mais de 50%, segundo dados da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior (Secex) divulgados nesta segunda-feira.
Até a segunda semana de setembro, os embarques de café somaram 107,9 mil toneladas (1,8 milhão de sacas de 60 kg), com média diária de 13,49 mil toneladas, versus 8,9 mil toneladas em setembro completo de 2025.
As exportações refletem a maior disponibilidade da grande safra brasileira, após o setor lidar com atrasos na colheita em [USN:S0N43X029 TEXT:"julho"]. Em agosto, o Conselho dos Exportadores de Café do Brasil (Cecafé) [USN:S0N44O08Y TEXT:"registrou recorde"] de embarques para o mês de mais de 4 milhões de sacas de 60 kg.
Já as exportações de petróleo alcançaram 5,25 milhões de toneladas até a segunda semana do mês, com média diária de 656,2 mil toneladas, salto anual de 75,6%. O desempenho acompanha a produção recorde do Brasil pelo [USN:L6N44T0SF TEXT:"segundo mês seguido"] em julho.
No caso da soja, as exportações continuaram elevadas, com o país exportando volumes de uma safra recorde. O Brasil embarcou 2,92 milhões de toneladas até a segunda semana de setembro, com média diária de 364,4 mil toneladas, alta de 9,2% ante setembro de 2025.
As exportações de milho, por outro lado, seguiram abaixo dos níveis observados há um ano, com o produto nacional menos competitivo do que o argentino e uma maior destinação de grãos para a produção local de etanol. Os embarques do cereal somaram 2,29 milhões de toneladas até a segunda semana de setembro, com média diária de 286,2 mil toneladas e queda de 16,7% em relação a setembro de 2025.
As exportações de carne bovina perderam força, somando 79,8 mil toneladas até a segunda semana de setembro, com média diária de 9,96 mil toneladas, queda de 30,3% no comparativo anual. O recuo, também registrado [USN:L1N4500TA TEXT:"em agosto"], ocorre em meio ao encerramento da cota de importação da China com tarifa mais baixa em 2026.

items.title: Bob Mackie, estilista das estrelas, morre aos 87 anos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O estilista de Hollywood Bob Mackie, conhecido por deixar estrelas como Cher e Elton John brilharem, faleceu nesta segunda-feira aos 87 anos, de acordo com uma postagem em sua conta oficial no Instagram.
items.body:
O estilista de Hollywood Bob Mackie, conhecido por deixar estrelas como Cher e Elton John brilharem, faleceu nesta segunda-feira aos 87 anos, de acordo com uma postagem em sua conta oficial no Instagram.
Sua carreira se estendeu por cinco décadas e incluiu a criação de uma coleção de roupas para as bonecas Barbie.
Nascido em 1939 em uma família de classe média em Monterey Park, na Califórnia, ele foi indicado a mais de 30 prêmios Emmy e ganhou nove. Recebeu indicações ao Oscar pelos figurinos usados nos filmes “O Ocaso de Uma Estrela”, “Funny Lady” e “Dinheiro do Céu”.
“Sua genialidade e seus designs extraordinários viverão para sempre, continuando a trazer beleza a este mundo”, disse sua equipe em uma postagem no Instagram. A causa da morte não foi divulgada.
Mackie era conhecido por lantejoulas, strass e glitter, mas também por seu humor. O destaque de seus 11 anos no programa “The Carol Burnett Show” foi o “vestido de cortina” usado por Burnett em um esquete que parodiava o clássico do cinema de 1939 “E o Vento Levou”. O figurino, hoje parte da coleção do Museu de História norte-americana do Smithsonian, incluía uma haste de latão equilibrada nos ombros de Burnett e um pedaço do acabamento da cortina usado como chapéu.

items.title: Taj Gibson retires; reportedly will join Bulls' coaching staff
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Seventeen-year veteran Taj Gibson announced his retirement from the NBA on Monday, and reports indicated that he will re-join the Chicago Bulls organization as an assistant coach.
items.body:
Seventeen-year veteran Taj Gibson announced his retirement from the NBA on Monday, and reports indicated that he will re-join the Chicago Bulls organization as an assistant coach.
Gibson, 41, spent his first eight seasons in Chicago after he was selected by the Bulls in the first round (26th overall) of the 2009 NBA draft. The center/power forward played for the Bulls from 2009-17, then competed for seven different teams over the next nine seasons.
The USC product played in 1,012 games, starting 462. He averaged 8.3 points and 5.7 rebounds per game and hit 51.7% of his field goal attempts.
"Today is a very emotional day for me," Gibson said in the social media post announcing his retirement. "After 17 seasons in the NBA, I can honestly say I gave this game everything I had. Basketball gave me the opportunity to live a dream. As a kid from Brooklyn, N.Y., I was lucky to get a chance to display my talent on the biggest stage. From Fort Greene Projects to USC, to the Chicago Bulls, and every team and city that came after, I'm grateful for every moment, every teammate, every coach, and every person who believed in me. I wanted to be the guy my teammates could count on someone who brought toughness, energy, leadership, and heart every time I stepped on the court.
"To my family, my friends, my teammates, my coaches, my agent, the NBA, NBPA and the fans, thank you. You were all a part of this journey. But this isn't goodbye to basketball. It's the beginning of a new chapter. After 31 years of basketball, I can walk away with no regrets, knowing I left everything on the floor. God has truly blessed me."
Gibson earned NBA All-Rookie honors after the 2009-10 season when he averaged 9.0 points and a career-high 7.5 rebounds per game. He had his most productive seasons in Chicago, peaking in the 2013-14 campaign when he averaged a career-high 13.0 points per game.
He played on six Bulls playoff teams and the team made its deepest run in 2010-11, reaching the Eastern Conference finals.
Gibson also played for the Oklahoma City Thunder (2017), Minnesota Timberwolves (2017-19), New York Knicks (2019-22, 2023-24), Washington Wizards (2022-23), Detroit Pistons (2024) and Charlotte Hornets (2024-25) before finishing with a ten-game stint for the Memphis Grizzlies (2026).
Gibson is expected to join the Bulls' staff headed by first-year head coach Tiago Splitter.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Report: Clippers-Raptors trade complete after Kawhi Leonard investigation delay
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The trade sending Clippers forward Kawhi Leonard back to the Toronto Raptors was officially signed off on by both teams on Monday after months of delay amidst the NBA's investigation into Los Angeles allegedly giving Leonard impermissible benefits, according to an ESPN report.
items.body:
The trade sending Clippers forward Kawhi Leonard back to the Toronto Raptors was officially signed off on by both teams on Monday after months of delay amidst the NBA's investigation into Los Angeles allegedly giving Leonard impermissible benefits, according to an ESPN report.
The trade, initially agreed to on June 30, sees Leonard return to Toronto, where he led the Raptors to the 2019 NBA championship. In return, the Clippers will receive forward Brandon Ingram, guard Gradey Dick, two unprotected first-round picks, one first-round pick swap and two second-round picks, according to the ESPN report.
Those acquired picks will help to replace the five first-round picks the league stripped from the Clippers for the $28 million "no-show job" the Clippers arranged for Leonard through one of their partners, Aspiration, in order to circumvent the salary cap. The NBA found Clippers also made arrangements to pay Leonard through team partners Boingo Wireless, Daktronics and Lockton Insurance.
Clippers owner Steve Ballmer announced Sunday night that he would accept the NBA's punishment, which included a one-year suspension and a $30 million fine along with the forfeited draft picks.
"This has been a very difficult time for everybody associated with the Clippers, and for that, I have sincere regrets," Ballmer said in a statement posted on the Clippers' X account. "I want to apologize to our fans, employees and my fellow NBA team owners for the distraction and the distress this matter has caused, for which I accept responsibility as principal owner."
Leonard, 35, averaged 25.1 points, 6.4 rebounds, 4.1 assists and 1.7 steals per game over 331 games (329 starts) across the past six seasons for the Clippers. The seven-time All-NBA player and two-time NBA Defensive Player of the Year was with the Raptors for just one very eventful season, where he anchored the first NBA title in franchise history before signing as a free agent with Los Angeles that offseason.
Leonard has averaged 20.7 points, 6.4 rebounds, 3.1 assists and 1.7 steals over 798 games (769 starts) across 14 seasons with the San Antonio Spurs (2011-18), Raptors (2018-19) and Clippers (2019-26).
Ingram, 29, was traded to Toronto ahead of the 2025-26 season and averaged 21.5 points, 5.6 rebounds and 3.7 assists while earning his second career All-Star nod. The No. 2 overall pick in the 2016 NBA Draft has career averages of 19.8 points, 5.2 rebounds and 4.2 assists over 572 games (533 starts) spanning 10 seasons for the Los Angeles Lakers (2016-19), New Orleans Pelicans (2019-2025) and Raptors.
Dick, 22, was the 13th overall pick by Toronto in 2023. He has averaged 9.2 points and 2.5 rebounds and hit 34.3% of his 3-point attempts over three seasons with the Raptors, although he averaged a career-worst 6.0 points and 30.1% shooting from outside the arc last season.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Wall Street fecha em baixa; apelos por desaceleração da IA castigam fabricantes de chips
items.author: Noel Randewich
items.creator: Noel Randewich
items.summary: Wall Street fechou em baixa nesta segunda-feira, pressionada pelas perdas da Nvidia e de outras fabricantes de chips, depois que altos executivos de empresas norte-americanas de inteligência artificial levantaram preocupações com a segurança e pediram uma desaceleração no desenvolvimento da IA.
items.body:
Wall Street fechou em baixa nesta segunda-feira, pressionada pelas perdas da Nvidia e de outras fabricantes de chips, depois que altos executivos de empresas norte-americanas de inteligência artificial levantaram preocupações com a segurança e pediram uma desaceleração no desenvolvimento da IA.
Os investidores também ficaram nervosos depois que a taxa de rendimento de referência dos títulos do Tesouro de 10 anos ultrapassou brevemente os 5% pela primeira vez desde 2023, antes da reunião do Federal Reserve desta semana. Espera-se amplamente que o banco central dos EUA aumente as taxas de juros.
Ações ligadas à IA despencaram em todo o mundo depois que os líderes da Anthropic, OpenAI e xAI alertaram sobre os riscos decorrentes do rápido desenvolvimento — a ameaça mais grave até agora aos bilhões de dólares que estão sendo injetados no setor e que levaram os mercados a níveis recordes.
As ações da Nvidia (NVDA.O) , da Broadcom (AVGO.O) , da Micron Technology (MU.O) e da Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) caíram, e o índice de chips PHLX (.SOX) registrou forte queda.
De acordo com dados preliminares, o S&P 500 (.SPX) perdeu 0,48%, fechando em 7.620,05 pontos, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuou 0,55%, para 26.187,79 pontos. O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caiu 0,29%, para 52.421,63 pontos.

items.title: US Treasury blocks Citgo, parent companies from governance changes
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department on Monday amended a Venezuela license to prevent any unauthorized changes that could alter governance at Venezuela-owned refiner Citgo Petroleum and its parent companies in the United States, PDV Holding and Citgo Holding.
items.body:
The U.S. Treasury Department on Monday amended a Venezuela license to prevent any unauthorized changes that could alter governance at Venezuela-owned refiner Citgo Petroleum and its parent companies in the United States, PDV Holding and Citgo Holding.
Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez has moved this year to [USN:L1N40I0RL TEXT:"regain control"] of the country's assets overseas and has changed law firms representing the nation in foreign court cases, following the formal recognition of her government by Washington.
Citgo's board of directors - appointed after an opposition-led National Assembly in Venezuela in 2019 severed the refiner's ties with its ultimate parent PDVSA - has not suffered any major changes recently, but opposition-controlled entities supervising Citgo are expected to [USN:L1N4510TR TEXT:"cease"] their role soon.
The Treasury's measure blocks the "appointment, removal or replacement of any director, officer or other corporate governance official" at Citgo and its U.S. parent companies, the department's Office of Foreign Asset Control said in the amended license.

items.title: Why Canada is moving closer to the European Union, and how it is doing it
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney is pursuing a new form of economic partnership with the European Union and both sides are talking about an agreement spanning multiple areas.
items.body: OTTAWA — Prime Minister Mark Carney is pursuing a new form of economic partnership with the European Union and both sides are talking about an agreement spanning multiple areas. Here’s what we know. A ‘unique’ arrangement with Europe EU Ambassador to Canada Geneviève Tuts said last week that both sides are looking at crafting “something unique” that would build on an existing strategic partner agreement and a free trade deal. Tuts said officials are identifying areas for further co-operation before talks take place to settle on a format for the deal. She said to expect discussions during Carney’s visit this week to the European Parliament in Strasbourg, France. Those discussions will be followed by the EU-Canada summit set for Oct. 29 and 30 in Canada, which will see Carney host European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President Antonio Costa. Media reports have described a sweeping, major partnership in the works. The Wall Street Journal suggested Carney was exploring whether Canada could become an “associate member” of the European Union. No such associate member status exists. “We’re not looking to become a member of the European Union,” Carney told reporters Sunday. He said Canada and the EU are seeking “a unique alliance” based on similar values and priorities, coupled with “very complementary strengths.” What might be in the agreement? Achim Hurrelmann, co-director of the Centre for European Studies at Carleton University, said it seems both sides are “scrambling for ideas of what to include” in this new partnership. He said the agreement might end up bringing together a lot of unrelated policies, such as collaboration on a European stockpile of critical minerals, university student exchanges and a digital trade agreement. Carney told Bloomberg News that Canada’s relationship with the EU could include enhanced labour mobility, educational opportunities and research co-operation. “It’s not going to be solved this week in Strasbourg, just to be clear. It’s the start of a process, but it’s a start of a high-ambition process,” he said in a filmed interview published Monday. Renew Europe, one of the eight political groupings in the EU Parliament, calls itself “the European sister political family of Canada’s Liberal party.” In March, the group called for a NATO-style trade pact with Canada, Japan and South Korea. Such a pact would see its members harmonize export controls to shield themselves from American and Chinese economic coercion. Renew called last week for a new “strategic association” with Canada on trade, investment, critical minerals, energy, artificial intelligence, research, student exchanges, defence and labour mobility. Why does Canada want to be closer with Europe? Both jurisdictions have felt the brunt of U.S. President Donald Trump’s policies upending decades of integrated defence and trade flows. Some U.S. Republicans say Trump simply wants NATO to shoulder more of the cost of its defence and wants to see and more benefits for Americans from preferential European access to the U.S. market. But Trump has repeatedly threatened the sovereignty of Canada, Iceland and Greenland, which is part of the Kingdom of Denmark. He also has targeted institutions like the International Criminal Court and the World Trade Organization, institutions countries rely on to limit dominance by superpowers. Canada was the first non-European partner in an EU loan program for joint defence projects called Security Action for Europe, or SAFE. Only one contract for Canada has emerged from the program so far. While the EU’s roughly 450 million citizens outnumber the 340 million people living in the U.S., it’s not clear the European market could absorb the goods and services Canadians have spent decades selling to the United States. Carney’s landmark January speech to the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland called on middle powers to forge tighter economic and security ties to counter coercion by great powers. But Carney also spoke in May about how a strong Canada “will help make America great again.” What does Europe want? Europe lacks easy access to many key commodities, including oil and gas and the critical minerals used in building electrical vehicles. Fuel deposits near Norway and the Netherlands and green energy sources are not able to meet the industry and consumer demand that had much of Europe relying on Russian gas until Moscow launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Trump’s war on Iran has choked critical supply lines, sending fuels costs soaring in Europe. European officials have talked for years about having Canada as a key provider of rare earths and fuels like liquefied natural gas. What are Canadians concerned about? Conservative MPs have spoken out forcefully about any tight partnership with Europe and have compared the idea of an EU “associate membership” with Trump’s talk of annexing Canada. Others note that 10 EU countries — including G7 peers France and Italy — still haven’t ratified a trade deal with Canada called CETA that took effect nine years ago. The deal has drastically boosted European exports to Canada, and to a lesser extent in the opposite direction. Conservative MP Adam Chambers called recently for the “immediate ratification of CETA by EU holdouts” and for an end to European restrictions on imports of some Canadian foods. Some EU countries limit Canadian imports over concerns about hormones or genetically modified crops. Analysts have suggested that Carney’s focus on Europe risks reinforcing a view in Asia that Ottawa prioritizes its historical ties over a younger continent with faster economic growth. What are Europeans concerned about? Hurrelmann said the EU is always careful about how it treats the United Kingdom when thinking about partnerships with other countries. The British exit from the bloc had deep effects on both sides of the English Channel and Brussels has been signalling it wants deeper ties with the U.K. The Wall Street Journal noted some on the European side worry that Carney merely wants to use stronger ties as leverage in trade talks with Washington. European countries also frequently encounter difficulties caused by interprovincial barriers to trade and accreditation. The EU co-ordinates regulations and labour laws across its member countries, while Canada still grapples with trucking rules and nursing credentials that vary by province. Is Canada joining the EU? Since 1957, the EU has required that member countries be located in Europe. That rule leaves Morocco out but could someday allow Georgia in. It almost certainly does not encompass Canada. Still, some Canadians, including former Alberta deputy premier Thomas Lukaszuk, have promoted the idea of Canada joining the bloc. European diplomats have repeatedly referred to the idea as a distraction from actual efforts to boost trade and co-ordinate on shared threats relating to the Arctic, Russia’s war on Ukraine and Chinese economic policies. Finnish President Alexander Stubb discussed the idea during an April visit to Ottawa. “It would be a marriage made in heaven,” he said. “Limits should be provided only by our brains.” In May, Kaja Kallas — vice-president of the European Commission and the EU’s foreign minister — took note of the idea in a recorded video message marking 50 years of formal ties between the EU and Canada. “Canada is even the first — and arguably the only — country outside Europe where support for the EU membership is higher than in some of our member states,” Kallas said. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Sept. 14, 2026 Dylan Robertson, The Canadian Press

Novas pesquisas eleitorais também ocuparam as atenções na bolsa paulista, enquanto investidores seguem atentos a potenciais reflexos da crise no STF e das investigações sobre o Banco Master na corrida presidencial.
A primeira sessão da semana ainda teve como pano de fundo alertas sobre os riscos envolvendo IA e novo avanço dos preços do petróleo no mercado internacional.

O volume financeiro no pregão somava R$22,31 bilhões antes dos ajustes finais.

items.title: Wells Fargo commercial banking head Manning to retire, Biodrowski to succeed
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Wells Fargo said on Monday that John Manning, executive vice president and head of commercial banking market coverage, would retire at the end of the year after more than three decades with the bank.
items.body:
Wells Fargo (WFC.N) said on Monday that John Manning, executive vice president and head of commercial banking market coverage, would retire at the end of the year after more than three decades with the bank.
Here are more details:
Manning's career spanned over 40 years in financial services, Wells Fargo said.
Chicago-based Rob Biodrowski will succeed Manning as head of commercial banking market coverage, starting in November.
"I'm honored to take on this role and build upon the strong foundation John and our teams have created," Biodrowski said in a statement.
Biodrowski currently serves as a division executive for the U.S. Midwest within Wells Fargo commercial banking.
He has over 20 years of financial services experience spanning commercial and investment banking leadership roles.
In his latest role as head of Wells Fargo's commercial banking market coverage, Biodrowski will lead over 2,000 bankers serving clients across the U.S. and Canada.
Market coverage serves companies with annual revenue usually ranging from $25 million to $2 billion across industries and sectors, according to Wells Fargo.

items.title: Washington state defeats church's appeal over healthcare coverage for abortion
items.author: Jonathan Stempel
items.creator: Jonathan Stempel
items.summary: A divided U.S. appeals court on Monday rejected a renewed challenge by a Seattle-area church to void a Washington state law that requires insurers offering maternity coverage in employee health plans to also cover abortions.
items.body:
A divided U.S. appeals court on Monday rejected a renewed challenge by a Seattle-area church to void a Washington state law that requires insurers offering maternity coverage in employee health plans to also cover abortions.
In a 2-1 decision, the 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals said the Cedar Park Assembly of God of Kirkland, Washington failed to show that the state's Reproductive Parity Act of 2018 targeted religious conduct or otherwise reflected "hostility" toward religion.
On the same grounds, the court also rejected the Pentecostal church's challenge to Washington's conscientious objection statute, a 1995 law that excuses employers such as Cedar Park from purchasing coverage for services they oppose on religious or moral grounds, but requires health carriers to tell enrollees how to obtain such services.
Dozens of conservative entities and Republican attorneys general of 18 U.S. states sided with Cedar Park, which according to the decision provides health insurance to about 140 people and has a sincere religious belief that abortion is sinful.
Lawyers for Cedar Park did not immediately respond to requests for comment. A spokesperson for Washington Attorney General Nick Brown's office welcomed the decision, saying the office was "proud to defend Washington state law," protecting access to reproductive healthcare while also safeguarding Washingtonians' religious and conscience rights.
Cedar Park claimed that Washington's laws violated its First Amendment constitutional right to the free exercise of religion. It said the laws worked together to undermine its religious objections to abortion, arguing that even if it declined to purchase abortion coverage, it facilitated abortion indirectly because the state required that employees be told how to obtain it.
It sued in 2019, when Kaiser Permanente began requiring abortion coverage in its group plan.
MAJORITY FINDS RATIONAL BASIS Writing for the majority, Circuit Judge Susan Graber said the Parity Act was rationally related to Washington's interest in ensuring improved access for insured residents to reproductive health care, while preserving everyone's fundamental right to exercise their religious beliefs and conscience.
Circuit Judge Consuelo Callahan dissented. She said the Parity Act wasn't neutral because it effectively took sides on abortion coverage, "an area of profound moral and religious disagreement," and treated some secular activities more favorably than Cedar Park's desired religious exercise.
Cedar Park is located in Bothell, Washington, about six miles (10 km) north of Kirkland.
In March 2025, the San Francisco-based appeals court dismissed Cedar Park's appeal, saying the church lacked legal standing to challenge the Parity Act.
The court later withdrew that opinion, and heard new arguments in January.
Graber and Circuit Judge Lucy Koh, who comprised Monday's majority, are appointees of former Democratic Presidents Bill Clinton and Joe Biden, respectively. Callahan was appointed by former Republican President George W. Bush.
The case is Cedar Park Assembly of God of Kirkland, Washington v. Kuderer et al, 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals, Nos. 23-35560 and 23-35585.
For Cedar Park: Rory Gray from Alliance Defending Freedom
For Washington: Tera Heintz and Marta Beaudreault from Washington Attorney General's office

items.title: ＥＵ、15歳未満のＳＮＳ・ＡＩチャットボット利用禁止を提案へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Foo Yun Chee

[ブリュッセル １４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Foo Yun Chee

[ブリュッセル １４日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）は、１５歳未満の子どもについて、交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）や動画共有プラットフォーム、人工知能（ＡＩ）チャットボット、オンラインゲームの利用を制限する禁止措置を提案する見通しだ。ロイターが入手した欧州委員会の文書で明らかになった。オンライン上の危険から子どもを守るための取り組みとしては、これまでで最も包括的な計画となる。

米メタ・プラットフォームズが運営するフェイスブックとインスタグラム、中国系動画投稿アプリ「ＴｉｋＴｏｋ（ティックトック）」、グーグル所有の動画投稿サイト、ユーチューブ、オープンＡＩが手掛ける対話型生成ＡＩ、チャットＧＰＴといった主要サービスが、子どもの健康や安全に及ぼす影響について、世界的に懸念が高まっている。 

今回のＥＵ提案は「ＥＵキッズ法（ＥＵ　Ｋｉｄｓ　Ａｃｔ）」の一環で、フォンデアライエン欧州委員長と欧州委のビルクネン副委員長（デジタル問題担当）が１７日に発表する。フォンデアライエン氏は、今後のＥＵ政策を示す１６日に予定されている一般教書演説の中で、一部詳細を明らかにする可能性がある。 

文書は「ＥＵのアプローチは、未成年者がデジタルサービスの大きな可能性の恩恵を受けられると同時に、虐待や搾取から彼らを守るものでなければならない。テクノロジー企業の子どもへのアクセスを制限すべきであり、その逆であってはならない」と記した。

また文書によると、企業は規制当局の執行および監督活動に充てるため、監督手数料を支払う必要がある。 

欧州委の提案は、動画ゲームプラットフォームも対象とし、年齢に応じて各種サービスへのアクセスを段階的に許可する。企業に課される義務は、サービスの種類や子どもの年齢に応じて異なる。

ただ、欧州委は今後、ＥＵ加盟国および欧州議会と草案の内容を詰める必要があり、法制化までには数カ月の時間を要する見通しだ。 

欧州委はコメントを控えた。

items.title: Persona acusada de la muerte de músico mexicano y su familia obtuvo naturalización en 2001
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Una de las personas acusadas de matar al músico mexicano Jonathan Meléndez, dos de sus familiares y una trabajadora en el Estado de México obtuvo la carta de naturalización mexicana en 2001 y no en fechas cercanas al crimen en septiembre de 2026, como dicen publicaciones en línea.
items.body:
Una de las personas acusadas de matar al músico mexicano Jonathan Meléndez, dos de sus familiares y una trabajadora en el Estado de México obtuvo la carta de naturalización mexicana en 2001 y no en fechas cercanas al crimen en septiembre de 2026, como dicen publicaciones en línea.
“¡Se NACIONALIZÓ el día del multihomicidio! Diego N, detenido por matar a una familia en Atizapán, entre ellos el tecladista de CamiloVIImx, obtuvo su nacionalización mexicana ese mismo día”, dice una publicación que comparte una copia de la Clave Única de Registro de Población (CURP) expedida el 2 de septiembre a nombre de Diego Rosen.
Meléndez, su esposa, su hija de 3 años y una joven trabajadora del hogar murieron a tiros en Atizapán de Zaragoza, Estado de México, el 1 de septiembre.
La Secretaría de Seguridad y Protección Ciudadana (SSPC) dijo en un comunicado que detuvo a dos hombres, entre ellos Diego Sebastián “N”, por su probable participación en el multihomicidio.
Aunque la copia del CURP en las publicaciones está fechada el 2 de septiembre, esta corresponde a la generación o expedición de la constancia de CURP, no a la fecha en que se obtuvo la naturalización.
Una consulta en el sistema de la Dirección General del Registro Nacional de Población e Identidad ( RENAPO ), que asigna la CURP, muestra que la persona obtuvo su nacionalidad mexicana mediante una carta de naturalización expedida en 2001.
Un trabajador del Gobierno del Estado de México dijo a Reuters el 8 de septiembre que la copia de la CURP en redes sociales corresponde a la persona detenida y que la fecha del documento en las publicaciones en redes sociales corresponde al día en que se obtuvo.
La Fiscalía General de Justicia del Estado de México dijo en un comunicado el 9 de septiembre que Diego Sebastián “N” y otra persona fueron vinculados a proceso por su probable participación en varios delitos, incluidos la muerte de dos o más personas, por lo que fueron ingresados a un reclusorio en la localidad de Tlalnepantla.
La Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores de México, encargada de expedir la nacionalidad a ciudadanos extranjeros, no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios.
VEREDICTO Falso. La persona señalada por el asesinato del músico Jonathan Meléndez obtuvo una carta de naturalización mexicana en 2001.
Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos.
Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

items.title: Serbia's President Vucic says he will run for prime minister amid student protests
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Serbia's President Aleksandar Vucic, a populist who has been president or prime minister for 12 years, said he would run for prime minister in an October 25 election, and thousands of opposition supporters rallied in Belgrade on Monday.
items.body:
Serbia's President Aleksandar Vucic, a populist who has been president or prime minister for 12 years, said he would run for prime minister in an October 25 election, and thousands of opposition supporters rallied in Belgrade on Monday.
Vucic has faced nearly two years of student-led [USN:L8N3WD05R TEXT:"anti-corruption demonstrations"] triggered by a railway station roof collapse that killed 16 people in the city of Novi Sad in November 2024.
On Monday evening, thousands gathered in central Belgrade to support parliamentary candidates for the "Students Win" movement, the main opposition. The candidates submitted certified signatures of their supporters, the initial step to get on the ballot.
Vucic, who said in June he would resign but did not give a date, called the snap election for October 25.
"I would like to inform you that on September 27 I will resign as president," Vucic told Pink TV on Sunday evening. "That evening I will address the nation and thank people for their support."
Some opposition parties including the Democratic Party and Kreni Promeni Movement have pledged their support to the student movement and will not field candidates.
At the rally, students carried Serbian flags and shouted "Students Win."
"We, as students, want to reset the system and start everything from the beginning, so that institutions can do their jobs," said student Stefan Lukic, who attended the event.
Students and opposition parties accuse Vucic and his allies of corruption and controlling the media, which they deny.

items.summary: The San Diego Padres reinstated first baseman Ty France from the paternity list and optioned second baseman Mason McCoy to Triple-A El Paso in advance of Monday's game at Colorado.
items.body:
The San Diego Padres reinstated first baseman Ty France from the paternity list and optioned second baseman Mason McCoy to Triple-A El Paso in advance of Monday's game at Colorado.
In his return to the Padres this season, the 32-year-old France is batting .294 with 20 home runs and 63 RBIs in 120 games. He is a career .266 hitter with 101 home runs and 427 RBIs over eight seasons and 960 games for five clubs after starting his career with the Padres in 2019.
McCoy, 31, is a career .181 hitter in 43 major league games since 2023.
The Padres entered MLB play Monday possessing the third and final wild-card playoff spot in the National League, 2 1/2 games ahead of their NL West rival the Arizona Diamondbacks.
--Field Level Media

items.title: CEO do Bank of America prevê queda de pelo menos 10% na receita de banco de investimento no 3º tri
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O Bank of America espera que suas receitas de banco de investimento caiam pelo menos 10% no terceiro trimestre, enquanto a receita de "sales and trading" deve permanecer estável, afirmou nesta segunda-feira o presidente-executivo da instituição, Brian Moynihan.
items.body:
O Bank of America (BAC.N) espera que suas receitas de banco de investimento caiam pelo menos 10% no terceiro trimestre, enquanto a receita de "sales and trading" deve permanecer estável, afirmou nesta segunda-feira o presidente-executivo da instituição, Brian Moynihan.
Ele projetou que a receita do banco de investimento ficaria entre US$1,6 bilhão e US$1,8 bilhão no terceiro trimestre, abaixo dos US$2 bilhões registrados no mesmo período do ano anterior.
"O que estamos vendo é que o mercado em geral de bancos de investimento caiu cerca de 10%", disse o executivo na conferência global de serviços financeiros do Barclays.
"Estamos com uma participação muito pequena em alguns dos negócios que tiveram mais atividade, então provavelmente teremos uma queda um pouco maior do que essa."
Moynihan afirmou que espera que a receita de "sales and trading" permaneça praticamente estável no terceiro trimestre, em comparação com os US$5,4 bilhões registrados no terceiro trimestre de 2025.
Ele afirmou que a carteira de negócios continua robusta, mas alertou que, se as taxas de juros subirem, isso poderá diminuir a demanda por financiamento.
"No momento, estamos vendo um fluxo constante e os pipelines estão se mantendo cheios", disse Moynihan.
Corretoras globais esperam que o Federal Reserve aumente as taxas de juros este ano, após leituras de inflação mais fortes do que o esperado reforçarem as apostas de que os formuladores de políticas continuarão a apertar a política monetária.
Moynihan disse que os consumidores ainda estão gastando e que a qualidade do crédito tem sido tão boa quanto em muito tempo.
"Estamos muito otimistas em relação à economia norte-americana como um todo", disse ele.
(Reportagem de Saeed Azhar e Pritam Biswas)

items.title: Are We Losing Control of AI? What’s Driving New Fears
items.author: William Norris, Nilushi Karunaratne and Thomas Pfeiffer
items.creator: William Norris, Nilushi Karunaratne and Thomas Pfeiffer
items.summary: For years, as artificial intelligence has evolved from the stuff of sci-fi movies to an app ordinary people have installed on their phones, tech leaders and some AI insiders have talked about the potential for it to escape human control and wreak havoc on society. Those fears have become impossible to ignore in recent days, driven by advances in the technology, a series of cybersecurity breaches involving AI agents, and new warnings from rank-and-file AI staffers.

items.title: Bennacer joins Qatar's Al Gharafa after leaving AC Milan
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Algeria midfielder Ismael Bennacer has joined Qatar Stars League side Al Gharafa after agreeing to terminate his contract with AC Milan by mutual consent, the club said on Monday.
items.body:
Algeria midfielder Ismael Bennacer has joined Qatar Stars League side Al Gharafa after agreeing to terminate his contract with AC Milan by mutual consent, the club said on Monday.
The 28-year-old played a key role in his country's triumphant 2019 Africa Cup of Nations campaign but was omitted from Algeria's squad for this year's World Cup.
Born in France, Bennacer joined Milan from Empoli in 2019, helping the club secure the 2021-22 league title.
However, recurring knee injuries disrupted his progress and led to loan spells at Olympique de Marseille and Dinamo Zagreb. The midfielder has not played a competitive match for Milan since 2025 as he struggled with fitness problems.

items.body:

[ニューヨーク １４日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は、約１％上昇した。サウジアラビアのエネルギー関連施設への新たな攻撃や中東での船舶への攻撃を受け、エネルギー供給を巡る懸念が強まった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が１．０７ドル（１．０％）高の１バレル＝１０５．６８ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．３４ドル（１．３％）高の１０１．３９ドル。両先物とも一時ほぼ５％急伸したが、トランプ米大統領がイランは米政府との合意を望んでいると述べたことを受け、上げ幅を縮小した。

items.title: Exportación de carbón de Venezuela podría formar parte de acuerdos, dice secretario de Interior EEUU
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las exportaciones de carbón venezolano podrían integrarse en acuerdos energéticos con Estados Unidos, dijo el lunes el secretario de Interior Doug Burgum.
items.body:
Las exportaciones de carbón venezolano podrían integrarse en acuerdos energéticos con Estados Unidos, dijo el lunes el secretario de Interior Doug Burgum.
"El carbón podría destinarse a la exportación", señaló Burgum en una rueda de prensa en Houston, añadiendo que este recurso también podría utilizarse para la generación domestica de electricidad.
"A medida que reconstruyamos la red eléctrica en Venezuela, necesitaremos más energía para el consumo local", afirmó.
Aunque Venezuela lleva años sin exportar carbón, la Oficina de Control de Activos Extranjeros (OFAC, por su sigla en ingles) modificó este mes una licencia para aclarar que las empresas estadounidenses pueden realizar negocios con los productores estatales de carbón de Venezuela.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル全面高、ＦＲＢ利上げ観測強まる　円は154円台前半
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　１４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　１４日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が今週の会合で２年以上ぶりとなる利上げに踏み切るとの見方が強まる中、ドルが全面高となった。中東情勢の緊迫化を背景とした原油高受けて安全資産とされるドルに資金が流入したほか、主要な人工知能（ＡＩ）企業トップがＡＩの潜在的な危険性について警鐘を鳴らしたこともリスク選好度の後退につながり、ドル支援要因になった。

主要通貨の中でも円は特に対ドルで軟調となり、終盤の取引でドル／円は０．５％高の１５４．３５５円。市場では日銀が１７―１８日に開く金融政策決定会合で利上げを実施するとの見方がほぼ織り込まれているが、その後も利上げが続くか見極めようとする動きが続いている。

ＦＲＢが１５─１６日に開く連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）についても利上げ観測が一段と強まっており、ＣＭＥグループのフェドウオッチによると、利上げが決定される確率は約９０％と、１週間前の約６０％から大きく上昇した。

三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ（ＭＵＦＧ）のシニア為替アナリスト、リー・ハードマン氏は「ＦＲＢが金融引き締め局面に入るとの見方が強まっていることを背景にドルは緩やかに上昇している」と指摘。スコシアバンクのショーン・オズボーン氏率いるアナリストチームは「ＦＲＢが政策金利の据え置きを決定すれば市場にとってサプライズとなり、ドルにとって明確な悪材料になる。利上げを決定しても、追加利上げの可能性を明確に示唆しない『ハト派的な利上げ』になれば、ドルの重しになる」としている。

イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）は１７日に開く金融政策委員会では金利据え置きを決定すると見込まれているが、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が１０日の理事会で０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定したことを受け、英中銀も年内に利上げに動くとの観測が強まっている。

世界的に利上げ観測が強まる中、米国や欧州、日本では国債利回りが数年から数十年ぶりの高水準へ上昇。ただ、各国の利回りがおおむね同じ方向に動いているため、外国為替相場への影響はこれまでのところ限定されている。

終盤の取引で、主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．３％高の９９．４１。一時９９．７３５に上昇し、９月２日以来の高水準を付けた。

ユーロ／ドル は一時１．１５３ドルに下落し、約１カ月ぶりの安値を更新。その後も０．２％安の水準で推移した。

英ポンド／ドルは０．２％安の１．３５１２ドル。

［ニューヨーク　１４日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が今週の会合で２年以上ぶりとなる利上げに踏み切るとの見方が強まる中、ドルが全面高となった。中東情勢の緊迫化を背景とした原油高受けて安全資産とされるドルに資金が流入したほか、主要な人工知能（ＡＩ）企業トップがＡＩの潜在的な危険性について警鐘を鳴らしたこともリスク選好度の後退につながり、ドル支援要因になった。

主要通貨の中でも円は特に対ドルで軟調となり、終盤の取引でドル／円は０．５％高の１５４．３５５円。市場では日銀が１７―１８日に開く金融政策決定会合で利上げを実施するとの見方がほぼ織り込まれているが、その後も利上げが続くか見極めようとする動きが続いている。

ＦＲＢが１５─１６日に開く連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）についても利上げ観測が一段と強まっており、ＣＭＥグループのフェドウオッチによると、利上げが決定される確率は約９０％と、１週間前の約６０％から大きく上昇した。

三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ（ＭＵＦＧ）のシニア為替アナリスト、リー・ハードマン氏は「ＦＲＢが金融引き締め局面に入るとの見方が強まっていることを背景にドルは緩やかに上昇している」と指摘。スコシアバンクのショーン・オズボーン氏率いるアナリストチームは「ＦＲＢが政策金利の据え置きを決定すれば市場にとってサプライズとなり、ドルにとって明確な悪材料になる。利上げを決定しても、追加利上げの可能性を明確に示唆しない『ハト派的な利上げ』になれば、ドルの重しになる」としている。

イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）は１７日に開く金融政策委員会では金利据え置きを決定すると見込まれているが、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が１０日の理事会で０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定したことを受け、英中銀も年内に利上げに動くとの観測が強まっている。

世界的に利上げ観測が強まる中、米国や欧州、日本では国債利回りが数年から数十年ぶりの高水準へ上昇。ただ、各国の利回りがおおむね同じ方向に動いているため、外国為替相場への影響はこれまでのところ限定されている。

終盤の取引で、主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．３％高の９９．４１。一時９９．７３５に上昇し、９月２日以来の高水準を付けた。

ユーロ／ドル は一時１．１５３ドルに下落し、約１カ月ぶりの安値を更新。その後も０．２％安の水準で推移した。

英ポンド／ドルは０．２％安の１．３５１２ドル。

items.title: Deshaun Watson expected to remain Browns' QB1 in Week 2
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Cleveland Browns head coach Todd Monken said Monday he anticipates keeping Deshaun Watson as the starting quarterback for the team's game at Tampa Bay next week despite his subpar return to action on Sunday.
items.body:
Cleveland Browns head coach Todd Monken said Monday he anticipates keeping Deshaun Watson as the starting quarterback for the team's game at Tampa Bay next week despite his subpar return to action on Sunday.
Watson, who had been sidelined since October 2024 due to a pair of Achilles tears, completed 16 of 22 passes for 205 yards with a touchdown and an interception in the Browns' season-opening 34-10 loss at Jacksonville. He also had six carries for a team-high 38 rushing yards,
The interception came on the opening series, while the touchdown pass came with 1:52 left in the game. Watson was also sacked five times while leading an offense that trailed 24-0 at halftime and managed one first down on its six first-half drives.
While Monken wasn't willing to commit to Watson remaining the starter in the immediate aftermath of Sunday's game, he solidified his plan for Week 2 after watching game film.
Watson's backup is second-year QB Shedeur Sanders, who had 1,400 passing yards, seven touchdowns and 10 interceptions in eight games last season.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Milei planea presentar un proyecto de ley para endurecer sanciones contra empresas que operan en Malvinas
items.author: Leila Miller
items.creator: Leila Miller
items.summary: El presidente argentino, Javier Milei, está preparando esta semana un proyecto de ley para endurecer sanciones contra firmas que operan en las Islas Malvinas, una medida que, según analistas, genera incertidumbre sobre si podría agravar las tensiones con el Reino Unido al centrarse en otros sectores de la economía de las islas en disputa.
items.body:
El presidente argentino, Javier Milei, está preparando esta semana un proyecto de ley para endurecer sanciones contra firmas que operan en las Islas Malvinas, una medida que, según analistas, genera incertidumbre sobre si podría agravar las tensiones con el Reino Unido al centrarse en otros sectores de la economía de las islas en disputa.
El proyecto de ley se basará en procedimientos sancionatorios que, según el Gobierno argentino, se han iniciado contra al menos 60 empresas y personas vinculadas a la exploración petrolera en alta mar en torno a las islas, a las que Argentina reclama como suyas a pesar de que están bajo control británico.
Argentina intentó recuperar las islas en 1982 y libró una guerra de 10 semanas antes de rendirse ante el Reino Unido.
Está previsto que el Congreso reciba la propuesta de presupuesto de Milei para 2027 este martes. Se espera que el mismo aumente el gasto en defensa para dar mayor prioridad a cuestiones de soberanía.
Este mes, el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, sugirió que Washington podría reconsiderar su postura tradicionalmente neutral en la disputa por las Malvinas. Desde entonces, Argentina ha acelerado sus esfuerzos para actuar contra las empresas implicadas en actividades de perforación petrolera en torno a las islas.
La propuesta legislativa de Milei incluye sanciones más severas para operaciones no autorizadas en las proximidades de las islas, según explicó a Reuters el asesor del Congreso Marcelo Seghini. Afirmó que ampliaría las sanciones a empresas asociadas y abarcaría otras actividades que afecten los recursos naturales de Argentina.
Esta medida se produce tras la [USN:L1N44Z0JM TEXT:"denuncia"] penal presentada la semana pasada contra empresas vinculadas al proyecto marítimo "Sea Lion" en las Malvinas.
El Gobierno argentino no ha respondido al pedido de comentarios de Reuters ni ha facilitado una lista de las empresas que sancionará, aunque medios locales han publicado algunos nombres.
Analistas afirmaron que no tenían claro el alcance del proyecto de "ley de defensa de la soberanía nacional" propuesto por Milei, pero calificaron sus sanciones como un esfuerzo agresivo por traducir las reivindicaciones de soberanía de Argentina en presión jurídica y comercial.
"No es un proyecto elaborado a lo largo del tiempo y preparado de manera meticulosa", dijo Marcelo Elizondo, representante de Argentina ante la Cámara de Comercio Internacional. El comentario de Trump "generó un clima que el Gobierno intentó aprovechar rápidamente", agregó.
Las empresas y los inversores están sopesando si las sanciones podrían afectar en última instancia a las empresas con operaciones en Argentina, incluidas las que participan en la vasta formación de petróleo de esquisto de Vaca Muerta.
El Gobierno ya ha enfrentado críticas por las sanciones.
La empresa holandesa especializada en datos geológicos Fugro publicó un comunicado en el que afirmaba que los medios locales la habían identificado erróneamente como colaboradora del proyecto "Sea Lion", y añadía que sus actividades en la zona se limitaban a trabajos relacionados con un cable submarino de telecomunicaciones.
SANCIONES GENERALIZADAS Los expertos señalaron que las medidas podrían complicar el desarrollo del proyecto "Sea Lion" al generar un efecto disuasorio entre las empresas que trabajan con los propietarios del proyecto, Navitas Petroleum y Rockhopper Exploration.
Ambas compañías han afirmado que el proyecto petrolero cuenta con licencias válidas del Gobierno de las Islas Malvinas y han indicado que no esperan que las medidas de Milei frenen su desarrollo.
Un documento gubernamental al que ha tenido acceso Reuters incluía a una serie de accionistas e intermediarios financieros entre las empresas señaladas para posibles sanciones. Entre ellas figuraban Vanguard, First Eagle, Canaccord, Interactive Investor (propiedad de Aberdeen) y Hargreaves Lansdown.
Las grandes petroleras SLB, Baker Hughes (BKR.O) y Halliburton (HAL.N) han declarado en los últimos días que no participarían en actividades en las islas.
"Sin grandes empresas de servicios, habría que ir a buscar otras empresas medianas con un perfil técnico no tan consolidado, tal vez más caras o no tan rápidas para operar", dijo Juan José Carbajales, exsubsecretario de Hidrocarburos del Gobierno de centroizquierda del presidente Alberto Fernández.
Seghini, el asesor parlamentario, dijo a Reuters que el Gobierno de Milei estaba barajando la posibilidad de ampliar las sanciones al sector pesquero en el proyecto de ley, lo que podría afectar a un sector que sustenta gran parte de la economía de las Islas Malvinas.
"Cuanto más se amplía la cadena de suministro, mayor es el riesgo de que estas sanciones resulten costosas", afirmó Federico Merke, politólogo de la Universidad de San Andrés de Buenos Aires.
PRESIÓN DE LA OPOSICIÓN El paquete de medidas sobre soberanía supondrá una prueba legislativa para Milei, cuya coalición libertaria carece de mayoría en el Congreso y ha tenido dificultades para conseguir apoyo para algunas reformas económicas.
Los opositores de centro e izquierda llevan tiempo acusando al libertario Milei de no hacer lo suficiente para defender la reivindicación argentina sobre las Malvinas, y ahora afirman que está actuando por motivos políticos de cara a una probable candidatura a la reelección en 2027.
"Está utilizando claramente las Malvinas por oportunismo político", dijo Aldo Leiva, diputado del partido opositor Unión por la Patria. "Si hubiera querido defender la soberanía de las Malvinas en estos dos años de gobierno, habría tenido las herramientas para hacerlo", agregó.
Marcelo García, analista de la consultora Horizon Engage en Buenos Aires, señaló que el proyecto de ley de Milei inquieta a los inversores porque podría ayudar a la oposición a obligarle a intensificar las medidas contra el Reino Unido.
"Ya existía preocupación por las elecciones del año que viene: ¿y si se produce una reacción populista en Argentina?", señaló García.
Francisco Cafiero, exsecretario de Relaciones Internacionales del Ministerio de Defensa, señaló que el episodio reflejaba una falta de claridad estratégica más generalizada.
"Aquí navegamos en medio de la incertidumbre y la improvisación", afirmó.

items.title: Videos de explosión de pirotecnia fueron grabados en Veracruz, no en el Estado de México
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Dos clips que muestran una explosión de fuegos pirotécnicos cerca de una iglesia fueron grabados en la localidad de Xico, Veracruz, y no corresponden al incidente del 5 de septiembre en Santa María Canchesda, en el Estado de México, como dicen publicaciones en línea.
items.body:
Dos clips que muestran una explosión de fuegos pirotécnicos cerca de una iglesia fueron grabados en la localidad de Xico, Veracruz, y no corresponden al incidente del 5 de septiembre en Santa María Canchesda, en el Estado de México, como dicen publicaciones en línea.
Ejemplos en redes sociales difunden los clips de una multitud que huye del atrio de una iglesia luego de que una estructura de fuegos pirotécnicos se incendiara y lanzara chispas.
El Gobierno del Estado de México dijo el 6 de septiembre que 10 personas murieron y 64 quedaron lesionadas por la detonación de material pirotécnico almacenado en un espacio utilizado como bodega en la noche del 5 de septiembre .
Sin embargo, los videos difundidos en redes sociales fueron grabados en la localidad de Xico , Veracruz y se comparten al menos desde el 2 de agosto.
Una comparación muestra que la estructura del edificio, incluido un adorno festivo en la fachada de la iglesia, y construcciones aledañas que se ven en uno de los clips coinciden con imágenes de Street View de Google Maps.
Protección Civil de Xico publicó en su página de Facebook el 1 de agosto que, tras un accidente de pirotecnia en una celebración, 21 personas presentaron quemaduras.
Las secretarías de Protección Civil del Estado de México y la de Xico no respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.
VEREDICTO Erróneamente etiquetados. Los videos fueron tomados en Xico, Veracruz y se comparten al menos desde el 2 de agosto.
Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos.
Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

items.title: CVC joins JC Flowers in potential bid for UK bank Aldermore, sources say
items.author: Amy-Jo Crowley
items.creator: Amy-Jo Crowley
items.summary: Private equity group CVC has joined forces with JC Flowers on a bid for FirstRand's UK bank arm Aldermore, two people familiar with the matter said.
items.body:
Private equity group CVC (CVC.AS) has joined forces with JC Flowers on a bid for FirstRand's UK bank arm Aldermore, two people familiar with the matter said.
The South African lender [USN:L4N40Q11W TEXT:"said"] in April it planned to exit from its small specialist British bank blaming a costly UK motor finance redress scheme, as it raised provisions for mis-sold motor loans to £750 million ($1.01 billion).
Aldermore’s owner FirstRand (FSRJ.J) has asked prospective buyers to submit non-binding offers on Tuesday, two of the people said.
FirstRand, Aldermore and CVC declined to comment. JC Flowers did not respond to a request for comment.
British bank NatWest (NWG.L) , Centerbridge and Warburg Pincus are also potential bidders for the unit that was first acquired by FirstRand in 2017, one of the people said. NatWest, Warburg Pincus and Centerbridge declined to comment.
The discussions further show how Britain's specialist and mid-sized banks, which have struggled in recent years to compete with larger incumbents, are undergoing consolidation. Examples include Nationwide's £2.9 billion purchase of Virgin Money in 2024 and Santander's takeover of TSB in 2025.
FirstRand [USN:PLXDG87WG TEXT:"said"] last week that it expected non-binding offers for the unit to be submitted by the end of this month.
Analysts at RBC this month estimated Aldermore's valuation at £1.35 billion excluding its motor finance business, or £1.45 billion when including that business.
Other potential bidders were expected to include the UK's Metro Bank and Lloyds, Sky News previously reported.
($1 = 0.7417 pounds)

items.title: Monsanto de Bayer insta a juez de Misuri a aprobar acuerdo de 7.250 millones de dólares por Roundup
items.author: Dietrich Knauth
items.creator: Dietrich Knauth
items.summary: Monsanto, filial de Bayer, instó el lunes a un juez de Misuri a que apruebe el acuerdo propuesto, por valor de 7.250 millones de dólares, para resolver las demandas en las que se alega que su herbicida Roundup provoca cáncer, alegando que no hay otra forma de resolver el litigio que ha afectado a la empresa por años.
items.body:
Monsanto, filial de Bayer, instó el lunes a un juez de Misuri a que apruebe el acuerdo propuesto, por valor de 7.250 millones de dólares, para resolver las demandas en las que se alega que su herbicida Roundup provoca cáncer, alegando que no hay otra forma de resolver el litigio que ha afectado a la empresa por años.
La compañía está intentando resolver casi todas las demandas por cáncer relacionadas con Roundup, tanto actuales como futuras, en Estados Unidos a través de una nueva demanda colectiva presentada en Misuri en febrero.
El juez Timothy Boyer escuchó los argumentos de los partidarios y detractores del acuerdo propuesto en una vista celebrada en Saint Louis.
Bayer (BAYGn.DE) niega que Roundup provoque cáncer, y el abogado de Monsanto, James Bennett, declaró ante el juez que la empresa está dispuesta a defenderse de las demandas ante los tribunales si se rechaza el acuerdo.
"Este es el acuerdo", afirmó Bennett en la vista judicial del lunes. "No hay otro acuerdo".
El juez también escuchó a varios abogados que se pronunciaron a favor del acuerdo, entre ellos los abogados de la demanda colectiva que lo negociaron algunos que inicialmente se opusieron a él.
Hunter Shkolnik, un abogado cuyo bufete representa a 3.000 demandantes de Roundup, explicó a Boyer que entre 800 y 900 de esos clientes querían inicialmente excluirse del acuerdo, pero que reconsideraron su postura y decidieron volver a sumarse después de que la Corte Suprema de Estados Unidos se pronunciara a favor de Monsanto en una cuestión jurídica clave en junio.
Shkolnik señaló que la sentencia de la Corte Suprema, que desestimó las alegaciones de que la etiqueta de Roundup debería haber advertido a los consumidores sobre los riesgos de cáncer del herbicida, supuso un duro golpe para muchos de los casos.
Los opositores han argumentado que el acuerdo no ofrece una indemnización suficiente y afirman que no se debería obligar a sus clientes a aceptar el marco propuesto por Bayer.
El acuerdo propuesto ofrece indemnizaciones que oscilan entre los 10.000 y los 165.000 dólares a las personas que estuvieron expuestas a Roundup y desarrollaron un linfoma no Hodgkin, un tipo de cáncer.
La indemnización exacta dependerá de factores como la gravedad del cáncer de la persona, la edad que tenía cuando se le diagnosticó y si estuvo expuesta a Roundup en casa o en el trabajo.
T. Roe Frazer, un abogado que se opone al acuerdo, argumentó que las indemnizaciones propuestas son insuficientes, señalando que los demandantes individuales no recibirían más de 165.000 dólares y que pocos cumplirían los requisitos para obtener la indemnización máxima.
Frazer también afirmó que el acuerdo no refleja el alcance potencial de futuras reclamaciones, ya que el Roundup sigue en el mercado y los estudios sugieren que el 80% de los estadounidenses ha estado expuesto al glifosato, el ingrediente clave del Roundup.
"Aunque 7 250 millones de dólares parezcan mucho dinero, simplemente no es suficiente", afirmó Frazer. "No puede serlo".
Bayer se enfrenta a aproximadamente 65.000 demandas en tribunales estatales y federales de Estados Unido presentadas por demandantes que afirman haber desarrollado cáncer tras utilizar Roundup en casa o en el trabajo.
El litigio ha supuesto una carga para Bayer desde su adquisición de Monsanto en 2018, lo que le ha costado a la empresa miles de millones de dólares y ha provocado una caída del precio de sus acciones.

Sept 14 : Dell chief Michael Dell's DFO Management, along with Sequence Holdings, will take Baldwin Group private in a $7.7 billion deal, the companies said on Monday, providing the insurance broker greater flexibility to pursue AI investments.
The deal reflects a growing shift to private ownership to finance costly AI upgrades. Operating outside public markets can allow managements to focus on long-term investments without the pressure of quarterly earnings cycle or share-price swings that often accompany short-term margin compression during major technological overhauls.
Baldwin shareholders will receive $32.50 apiece in cash, implying a premium of about 88 per cent to the stock's June 17 closing — the unaffected share price before media reports emerged about a potential deal. Its shares were up 7.5 per cent at $31.89 on Monday.
"This is a strong transaction for Baldwin and a positive signal for the brokerage sector. Insurance brokerages remain attractive investments because they offer recurring revenue, strong cash flow and significant opportunities for consolidation in a still-fragmented market," said Peter McMurtrie, partner at consulting firm West Monroe's Insurance Practice.

Baldwin, valued at around $4.14 billion, provides risk management solutions, insurance advisory and tech-enabled underwriting to businesses and individuals.
The deal — led by DFO Management, the investment vehicle for Dell Technologies' founder and CEO — will provide Baldwin with patient capital, bypassing the rigid investment timelines and forced exits typical of traditional private-equity firms.
"This transaction allows us to deliver immediate value to shareholders while establishing a partnership with Sequence and DFO that will give Baldwin the long-duration capital and frontier AI execution to invest and move at the pace this moment demands," CEO Trevor Baldwin said.
After the deal's closing, expected in the first quarter of 2027, eligible Baldwin employees will have the option to roll over a portion of their holdings, retaining a significant minority equity stake in the newly private enterprise.

items.title: U.S. imposes Iran-related sanctions on Russia's VTB
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The United States imposed Iran-related sanctions Monday on Russia's VTB Bank Public Joint Stock Company, accusing it of involvement in Iranian sanctions evasion, the Treasury Department said as Washington seeks to ramp up economic pressure on Tehran.
items.body:
The United States imposed Iran-related sanctions Monday on Russia's VTB Bank Public Joint Stock Company, accusing it of involvement in Iranian sanctions evasion, the Treasury Department said as Washington seeks to ramp up economic pressure on Tehran.
The action builds on sanctions imposed against VTB, Russia's second-largest lender, in 2022, when the bank [USN:L1N2UZ3MI TEXT:"was targeted"]following Moscow's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
“Under Operation Economic Outcast, Treasury will continue to target and disrupt those who provide material, technological, or financial support that allows the Iranian regime to sustain its terrorist enterprise,” Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in the statement.
“Treasury will not tolerate any support to the regime and will continue to identify, expose, and isolate Iran’s enablers.”
Bessent warned last week that President Donald Trump's administration would sanction a large bank as it continues to apply economic pressure on Tehran to end a more than six-month U.S. conflict with Iran.
The United States has imposed a range of economic measures against Iran since the conflict began in February, targeting oil exports, shipping networks, weapons procurement channels, financial intermediaries, digital asset exchanges and aviation links.

items.title: NFL season opener ratings down 11% for Pats-Seahawks; Australia game draws 18.5M
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The NFL's decision to move its first game of the regular season up a day to Wednesday did not seem to pay off in terms of television ratings.
items.body:
The NFL's decision to move its first game of the regular season up a day to Wednesday did not seem to pay off in terms of television ratings.
Wednesday's Week 1 Super Bowl rematch between the defending-champion Seattle Seahawks and visiting New England Patriots drew 25.1 million viewers on NBC and Peacock.
The television ratings were down 11% from last year's opening game between the Dallas Cowboys and Philadelphia Eagles, which was played on a Thursday night and delayed over an hour due to inclement weather. That Cowboys-Eagles game was the least-viewed opening game of an NFL season since 2022.
The viewership numbers in the 18-49 age range were strong. This year's Patriots-Seahawks game was the most-viewed in that age group for an NFL opener since 2021, according to NBC.
The game on Thursday between the San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams in Melbourne, Australia averaged 18.5 million viewers on Netflix. It peaked at 21.3 million in the 9:30-9:45 p.m. ET time frame, before the 49ers separated after halftime in the 27-7 victory.
Globally, the 49ers-Rams game drew 21.7 million, and was the most-viewed NFL game of all time in Australia.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Texans LB Henry To'oTo'o to miss time with shoulder injury
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Houston Texans linebacker Henry To'oTo'o is expected to miss an undetermined amount of time with a left shoulder injury, head coach DeMeco Ryans told reporters Monday.
items.body:
Houston Texans linebacker Henry To'oTo'o is expected to miss an undetermined amount of time with a left shoulder injury, head coach DeMeco Ryans told reporters Monday.
To'oTo'o walked off the field during Sunday's season opener against the Buffalo Bills favoring his left arm. He reportedly had his arm in a sling following the 36-31 defeat.
"Unfortunately, Henry has a shoulder injury and will be out for some time," Ryans said.
Ryans did not say if a trip to injured reserve was forthcoming.
In the opener of his fourth NFL season, To'oTo'o had two tackles on 51 snaps. In 48 career games (36 starts), all for the Texans, To'oTo'o has 263 tackles with four sacks, two forced fumbles and one interception.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Netanyahu afirma que el documental sobre Gaza "NAZA" es una "incitación escandalosa"
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El primer ministro israelí, Benjamin Netanyahu, afirmó el lunes que un nuevo documental —en el que se alega que las muertes masivas de civiles se tenían en cuenta de forma habitual a la hora de decidir los objetivos en Gaza— formaba parte de una ola de incitación mundial contra los judíos.
items.body:
El primer ministro israelí, Benjamin Netanyahu, afirmó el lunes que un nuevo documental —en el que se alega que las muertes masivas de civiles se tenían en cuenta de forma habitual a la hora de decidir los objetivos en Gaza— formaba parte de una ola de incitación mundial contra los judíos.
"NAZA", dirigida por los periodistas israelíes Yuval Abraham y Rachel Szor, ganó el sábado el Premio Especial del Jurado en el Festival de Cine de Venecia y recibió una ovación de 25 minutos cuando se proyectó el jueves.
La película toma su título de un término militar israelí que se refiere a las "bajas colaterales" previstas y se basa en entrevistas anónimas con oficiales de inteligencia y soldados que participaron en la guerra.
"Es escandaloso. Estamos luchando contra la incitación antisemita a nivel mundial y, cuando proviene de nuestro propio seno, resulta intolerable", declaró Netanyahu en un video publicado en Telegram. "Y ahora, dos directores israelíes que retratan a las FDI (Fuerzas de Defensa de Israel) como criminales de guerra reciben aplausos en el festival de Venecia".
Los comentarios de Netanyahu se produjeron tras una declaración del jefe militar israelí, Eyal Zamir, quien afirmó que la película constituía un ataque contra el Estado de Israel.
"A juzgar por lo publicado hasta ahora, no se trata de una película que ofrezca una crítica a las FDI, ni es un intento de establecer la verdad. Se basa en calumnias sangrientas, distorsiones deliberadas de la realidad y acusaciones graves y falsas contra soldados y mandos de las FDI", afirmó Zamir.
El ejército indicó que Zamir ha dado instrucciones al fiscal general militar, cuyas competencias jurídicas se limitan al ámbito militar, "para que examine y impulse posibles medidas legales en relación con la película y con quienes participan en ella".
No fue posible contactar de inmediato con los realizadores de la película para recabar sus comentarios.
"Creemos que la negación de un crimen es lo que contribuye a que persista y, por eso, para nosotros es especialmente importante que los israelíes vean esta película: es nuestro país el que está cometiendo estos crímenes", afirmó Abraham en su discurso de agradecimiento el sábado.
Las autoridades sanitarias de Gaza afirman que más de 73.000 palestinos, la mayoría de ellos civiles, han perdido la vida en la campaña militar de Israel, que ha dejado gran parte de Gaza en ruinas.
La guerra se desencadenó tras el ataque de Hamás contra Israel el 7 de octubre de 2023, en el que murieron 1.200 personas, la mayoría de ellas civiles.
Israel afirma que ha hecho todo lo posible por evitar víctimas civiles en su lucha contra los militantes de Hamás, que se atrincheran en lugares como hospitales, escuelas y refugios. Hamás niega utilizar a los civiles de Gaza como escudos humanos.

人工知能（ＡＩ）をけん引する企業トップが開発の減速を呼びかけたことを受け、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は２．１２％安。フランスの半導体材料大手ソイテックは１２．６％下落した。

一方、フランスのＩＴサービス大手キャップジェミニは６．６％、会計ソフトのセージ・グループは５．３％、情報分析のレレックスは５．２％いずれも上昇した。

資源株指数は２．５２％下落。原油価格は上昇したものの、石油・ガス株指数は０．７６％安。

ヘルスケア株指数は２．７４％上昇。ＧＳＫは４．７％高。２種類の肺がん治療薬の試験結果が良好だったと発表し、買われた。

市場では、主要中央銀行が年内に利上げするとの観測が高まっている。欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）当局者らはユーロ圏のインフレ率が予測を上回る可能性があると指摘する中、先週の利上げに続き、年内に少なくともあと１回の利上げを見込んでいる。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が今週の会合で利上げするとの見方も強まっている。 

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

域内国債利回りが上昇し、独１０年債利回りは２００９年半ば以来の高水準を付けた。原油価格が上昇する中、市場は今週開かれる主要中央銀行会合を前に、世界の中銀による金融引き締めを織り込んだ。

世界の債券市場は、エネルギー価格の上昇やインフレ加速・金利上昇への懸念の高まりを受けて圧力にさらされており、利回りは繰り返し過去数年ぶりの高水準を更新している。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは先週、１６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）超上昇し、週間ではイラン戦争開戦直後の３月第１週以来の上昇幅を記録した。

同利回りは１４日には４ｂｐ以上上昇し、１７年超ぶりの高水準となる３．５５４４％を付けた。

今週は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、日銀、イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）など主要中銀が金融政策を決定する予定で、市場ではその動向に注目が集まっている。 市場はＦＲＢと日銀が利上げに踏み切ると予想。一方、英中銀は政策据え置きが見込まれるものの、その決定は僅差になる可能性が高い。

金融市場は年内にＥＣＢが少なくともあと１回利上げを実施すると予想。２７年２月までに２５ｂｐの利上げを２回行うとの見方を完全に織り込んでいる。

ＥＣＢの政策金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは１３ｂｐ上昇の３．３％と、２３年終盤以来の高水準。

イタリア２年債利回りは１４ｂｐ上昇の３．５３３％。

items.title: Bank of America CEO sees at least 10% drop in Q3 investment banking fees
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bank of America expects its investment banking fees to drop by at least 10% in the third quarter, while sales and trading revenue will be flat, CEO Brian Moynihan said on Monday.
items.body:
Bank of America (BAC.N) expects its investment banking fees to drop by at least 10% in the third quarter, while sales and trading revenue will be flat, CEO Brian Moynihan said on Monday.
Shares of BofA extended losses after his comments, dropping over 5% by late afternoon trade. The S&P 500 banking index (.SPXBK) was down 2.7%.
Moynihan projected investment banking revenue to be between $1.6 billion and $1.8 billion in the third quarter, down from $2 billion in the same period a year earlier.
"What we're seeing is the market generally in investment banking is down 10% or so," he said at the Barclays global financial services conference.
"We're down to small position in some of the businesses that had more activity, so we'll be down probably a bit more than that."
Moynihan said he expects sales and trading revenue to be roughly flat in the third quarter, versus $5.4 billion in the third quarter of 2025.
He said the deals pipeline remains strong, but cautioned if interest rates go up, that will slow down some of the financing demand.
"Right now we're seeing it solid, and the pipelines are staying full," Moynihan said.
Global brokerages [USN:FWN45400Q TEXT:"expect the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates this year"] after stronger-than-expected inflation readings reinforced bets that policymakers will keep tightening monetary policy.
Moynihan said consumers are still spending and credit quality has been as good as "it's been (for) a long time."
"We feel very good about the underlying U.S. economy," he said.

items.title: Portada atribuida a diario mexicano Metro sobre política de Morena no es auténtica
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Una portada atribuida al periódico Metro sobre Citlalli Hernández, presidenta de la Comisión Nacional de Elecciones del partido Morena, no es auténtica y su autor dijo que fue creada con inteligencia artificial.
items.body:
Una portada atribuida al periódico Metro sobre Citlalli Hernández, presidenta de la Comisión Nacional de Elecciones del partido Morena , no es auténtica y su autor dijo que fue creada con inteligencia artificial.
Un ejemplo en Facebook que difundió la imagen que simula la portada dice que Hernández declaró: "Mientras yo esté, ¡No habrá PAN!".
La imagen tiene una marca de agua que dice @grandesexytos. Un usuario en Instagram con ese nombre, que se identifica como un creador de contenido con IA, la publicó el 10 de agosto.
El usuario dijo el 31 de agosto en un mensaje en Instagram que la imagen fue generada con ChatGPT. Además, compartió un artículo del diario El Universal que cita una publicación en X del 9 de agosto de Hernández.
La cuenta dijo que hizo un juego de palabras sobre una declaración de Hernández y que la interpretación depende de los lectores. "Se acomodaron las palabras para tener un doble sentido", añadió.
Un análisis realizado con la herramienta de detección de OpenAI determinó que la imagen probablemente fue editada o creada usando los modelos de inteligencia artificial de la compañía. La herramienta de verificación detecta marcas de agua invisibles incrustadas en los contenidos generados.
El área jurídica de Grupo Reforma dijo el 4 de septiembre en un correo electrónico que no publicaron el contenido en cuestión y que la cuenta usa de forma "ilegal" la marca del diario Metro.
Una revisión en las redes sociales del diario Metro no arrojó el contenido que le atribuyen.
La portada y contraportada del Metro del 10 de agosto son diferentes de la imagen que le atribuyen en línea, de acuerdo con una síntesis informativa de la Jefatura de Gobierno de la Ciudad de México.
VEREDICTO Sátira. Una portada atribuida al diario Metro sobre Citlalli Hernández no es auténtica y su autor dijo que fue creada con inteligencia artificial.
Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos.
Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

items.title: Bob Mackie, fashion designer for the stars, dies at 87
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Hollywood designer Bob Mackie, known for making stars such as Cher and Elton John sparkle, died on Monday at 87, according to a post on his official Instagram account.
items.body:
Hollywood designer Bob Mackie, known for making stars such as Cher and Elton John sparkle, died on Monday at 87, according to a post on his official Instagram account.
His career spanned five decades and included designing a Barbie doll clothes collection.
Born in 1939 into a middle-class family in Monterey Park, California, he was nominated for more than 30 Emmys, winning nine. He received Academy Award nominations for costumes worn in the films "Lady Sings the Blues," "Funny Lady," and "Pennies From Heaven."
"His genius and extraordinary designs will live on forever, continuing to bring beauty into this world," his team said in an Instagram post. His cause of death was not stated.
Mackie was known for sequins, rhinestones and glitter, but also humor. The highlight of his 11-year run for The Carol Burnett Show was the "curtain dress" worn by Burnett in a sketch parodying 1939 film classic "Gone with the Wind." The costume, now in the collection of the Smithsonian's American History Museum, included a brass curtain rod balanced on Burnett's shoulders and a bit of valance worn as a hat.
